seo.title: 5 kW vertical-axis wind turbine from the maker — UA GREEN
seo.description: K5 5 kW vertical-axis wind turbine made in Ukraine, from {price}. 1.5 m/s cut-in, 38 dB, 12–24 m mast, installation in 21 regions of Ukraine.

items.q: How much does a 5 kW vertical-axis wind turbine cost?
items.a: The K5 costs {price}. The kit has the 5 kW 48 V turbine, a 5 kW MPPT charge controller, a 5 kW ballast load and 50 m of cable. A 12, 18 or 24 m mast and installation are options on the product page.

items.q: How much electricity does a 5 kW wind turbine produce?
items.a: The K5 reaches its rated 5 kW (6.5 kW peak) at 12 m/s. Its year-round average output is 1.3–2 kW, roughly 11–17 MWh a year; winter output is about 30 % higher than summer. A wind audit gives the exact figure for your site.

items.q: What wind does the K5 need?
items.a: The rotor starts at 1.5 m/s, works from 2 to 25 m/s and is rated at 12 m/s. It withstands winds up to 45 m/s, and in strong wind the ballast load brakes the rotor.

items.q: Vertical or horizontal: which is better for a home?
items.a: A horizontal turbine yields more in strong, steady wind. A vertical one takes wind from any direction with no tail vane or yawing, handles gusts, turns slowly (125 rpm) and quietly at 38 dB, so it suits a house with people around.

items.q: What mast and foundation are needed?
items.a: The 12, 18 or 24 m mast is built from 6 m flanged sections with a service ladder. It stands on a reinforced concrete foundation with an anchor plate.

items.q: How does it connect to a house and solar panels?
items.a: The MPPT controller charges 48 V batteries and a hybrid inverter powers the house. Solar panels can join the same inverter for a wind-solar system. We size the kit to your consumption.

items.q: How often does it need service, and when does it pay back?
items.a: Service is once a year or every 12–15 MWh, from the ladder on the mast. The generator is gearless, so little can wear. Payback depends on the tariff: on average 1–2 years for a business and 5–6 years for a household.

items.q: Where is the K5 made and how do I get one?
items.a: We build the generator and blades ourselves in Ukraine; 80 % of the parts are Ukrainian. We deliver across Ukraine or you collect in Lviv, and we install in 21 regions. Pay by card, invoice or 0 % credit.

story.title: From raw stock to wind.
story.lead: We build the K5 vertical-axis wind turbine ourselves, from winding the stator to installing it on your site. Scroll and watch how.
story.svgLabel: How the K5 wind turbine is manufactured, assembled and installed

s1.h: The heart of K5 is a permanent-magnet generator.
s1.p: Electrical-steel stator, copper winding, 72 neodymium magnets. No gearbox, nothing to wear out.

s2.h: Three composite blades, layer by layer.
s2.p: Glass fabric from 48 to 400 g/m², epoxy, foam spar. Laid up in the mould layer by layer, cured, painted, balanced.

s3.h: Assembled and turned for the first time.
s3.p: Ø170 shaft, struts, blades onto the generator. The rotor has to start from 1.5 m/s.

s4.p: Rebar cage, concrete, anchor plate. A 12, 18 or 24 m mast bolts together at flanges, with a service ladder.

s5.h: The rotor seats on the mast. The cable goes indoors.
s5.p: MPPT controller, ballast load, batteries. From here on, only the wind works.
